name: Direction And Distance
body:
School divination; Level druid 2, fateshaper 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target willing creature touched
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

The touched target knows the direction and distance they must travel to reach you. This does not reveal the best or quickest route to do so, only the most direct.

This does not work if you and the target are on separate planes or either creature enters an antimagic area, the effect is suppressed.
